entities.summary: Elijah Wilson is an American professional basketball player who last played for Start Lublin of the Polish Basketball League. He played collegiately for Coastal Carolina before turning professional in 2017. He formerly played in Austria. He won the 2019 ABL championship with Kapfenberg Bulls and afterwards was named the Finals MVP.
